column3: note — candidate synsets for the space pack (Peter, 2026-09-03: geography, Earth, SPACE — only the uncontested, stable and certain; integrate with the existing space representations). The physics pack already holds WordNet's astronomy *topic* nouns (celestial-culmination, orbital-node, red-shift, meteoroid); this pack takes the cones: bodies, orbits, coordinates, spaceflight.
